correctness.rationale: For the explicitly specified unweighted 18-vertex cubic bipartite Pappus graph and its 27-vertex line graph, independently generated all graph-distance<=2 cliques. Complete finite face vectors: (18,81,108,18) and (27,162,270,135,27); independent F2 simplicial differential ranks (17,64,18) and (26,136,108,27). Reduction mod 2 bounds Q ranks from below, and connectedness plus Euler characteristic 27 yields rational H2 dimension 26 and no other reduced rational homology. Independently enumerated all 216 Pappus automorphisms and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz sums; full 12 character classes agree with submitted table, exactly 9 side-preserving involutions with (-10,2) and 18 side-exchanging with (2,-4) distinguish the actions. A finite exact exhaustive computation is appropriate for this one graph; no integral torsion or homotopy equivalence of Y is concluded.
